definitions.explanation: To repeat a question or request because one didn't hear or understand the first time.
To listen to something again, especially to music or audio recordings, to hear it better or with fresh ears.

examples.japanese: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧{聞|き}き{直|なお}した。
⟦すみません→すみません：00998_sumimasen⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧{聞|き}き{直|なお}しても⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

examples.english: When I re-listened to an album I loved when I was young after many years, the feelings from that time came flooding back.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB: ⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (to listen/ask) + ⟦{直|なお}す→直す：18371_naosu⟧ (to redo, to do again) = to listen/ask again

TRANSITIVITY: Transitive. Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ when there is a specific object being listened to again.

CONJUGATION (godan verb):
・{聞|き}き{直|なお}して (te-form)
・{聞|き}き{直|なお}した (past)
・{聞|き}き{直|なお}せる (potential)
・{聞|き}き{直|なお}される (passive)

RELATED ～{直|なお}す COMPOUND VERBS:
・⟦{言|い}い{直|なお}す→言い直す：08256_iinaosu⟧ - to say again, to rephrase
・⟦{書|か}き{直|なお}す→書き直す：04597_kakinaosu⟧ - to rewrite
・⟦{見|み}{直|なお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧ - to reconsider, to look at again
・⟦{読|よ}み{直|なお}す→読み直す：29840_yominaosu⟧ - to reread
・⟦やり{直|なお}す→やり直す：03172_yarinaosu⟧ - to redo

USAGE NOTE: When asking someone to repeat what they said, ⟦{聞|き}き{返|かえ}す→聞き返す：18247_kikikaesu⟧ is also used and emphasizes the interactive exchange. {聞|き}き{直|なお}す can be used both for asking someone to repeat and for listening to recordings again.
